environment.description: Flask application deployed on a Kubernetes cluster behind an nginx ingress controller with standard TLS termination. The ingress is configured with `nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/ssl-redirect: 'true'` and a standard Let's Encrypt server certificate. No client certificate verification is configured. The /api/v1/config/update endpoint is accessible to any client that can reach the ingress IP on port 443. Network policies allow ingress from any source CIDR.
